gate_coh.rule: at least 0.85 of the same-token sets labelled coherent and 0.85 of the mixed sets labelled mixed, declines in the denominator (SPEC3 §3 Stage 1)

O_star_jobs.what: O* jobs with both halves labelled coherent, over the 129 distinct O* jobs (ceiling splits)

primary_jobs_coherent_O.what: primary jobs whose O* job is coherent, over the 150 primary jobs

J.what: primary jobs whose J set is labelled coherent, over the 150 primary jobs

coherent_pairs.what: primary jobs with J and both O* halves coherent (Stage 2's primary items)

predictions.row: share of O* jobs coherent (both halves)

stage2.rule: Stage 2 runs only if gate coh passes; its items are the coherent pairs and the ceiling splits of coherent O* jobs (SPEC3 §3)
